src: As may be seen from the original programme printed in Erdmann's History of Philosophy under the date 1890, the Library of Philosophy was designed as a contribution to the History of Modern Philosophy under the heads: first of different Schools of Thought—Sensationalist, Realist, Idealist, Intuitivist; secondly of different Subjects—Psychology, Ethics, Æsthetics, Political Philosophy, Theology. While much had been done in England in tracing the course of evolution in nature, history, economics, morals, and religion, little had been done in tracing the development of thought on these subjects. Yet "the evolution of opinion is part of the whole evolution".

By the co-operation of different writers in carrying out this plan it was hoped that a thoroughness and completeness of treatment, otherwise unattainable, might be secured. It was believed also that from writers mainly British and American fuller consideration of English Philosophy than it had hitherto received might be looked for. In the earlier series of books containing, among others, Bosanquet's History of Æsthetics, Pfleiderer's Rational Theology since Kant, Albee's History of English Utilitarianism, Bonar's Philosophy and Political Economy, Brett's History of Psychology, Ritchie's Natural Rights, these objects were to a large extent effected.

In the meantime original work of a high order was being produced both in England and America by such writers as Bradley, Stout, Bertrand Russell, Baldwin, Urban, Montague, and others, and a new interest in foreign works, German, French, and Italian, which had either become classical or were attracting public attention, had developed. The scope of the Library thus

became extended into something more international, and it is entering on the fifth decade of its existence in the hope that it may contribute in this highest field of thought to that Intellectual Co-operation which is one of the most significant objects of the League of Nations and kindred organizations.

zh: 正如在艾爾德曼《哲學史》中根據1890 年日期印出的原始計劃所顯示的，哲學圖書館的設計是為了對現代哲學史作出貢獻，分為：首先是不同的思想流派——感官主義、現實主義、理想主義、直觀主義；其次是不同的學科——心理學、倫理學、美學、政治哲學、神學。儘管在英國已經對自然、歷史、經濟、道德和宗教的演變進行了大量研究，但在這些主題上的思想發展卻鮮有追溯。然而，「觀點的演變是整體演變的一部分」.
藉由不同作者合作執行此計畫，人們希望能獲得原本無法達到的徹底與完整的論述。人們也相信，主要來自英國與美國的作者將能對英國哲學給予至今尚未獲得的更深入考量。在先前的書籍系列中，其中包括博斯昆克的《美學史》、弗萊德勒爾自康德以後的《理性神學》、阿爾比的《英語功利主義史》、博納的《哲學與政治經濟學》、佈雷特的《心理學史》、裡奇的《自然權利》，這些目標在很大程度上已經實現。
此時，高水準的原創著作正在英格蘭和美國由布萊德利、斯托特、伯特蘭·羅素、鮑德溫、厄本、蒙塔古等作家產出；同時，對德文、法文和義大利文等外國作品的新興興趣也已發展，這些作品要麼已成為經典，要麼正在吸引公眾注意。圖書館的範圍因此
擴展為更具國際性的事物，而且它正進入其存在的第五個十年，希望它能在這最高的思考領域中，為那種智性合作作出貢獻，而智性合作是國際聯盟及其類似組織最重要的目標之一。
